   278	/-- Pasting two consistent measurements yields a product-form polynomial
   279	error. All operator families in the conclusion are the postprocessed source
   280	families. This is `lem:pasting`, blueprint `ch12_qpbt_games.tex:517-546`, paper
   281	`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:504-525`. -/
   282	theorem exists_pasting_error :
   283	    ∃ δp : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, IsPolyErr₂ δp ∧
   284	      ∀ {X Y₁ Y₂ R₁ R₂ Γ₁ Γ₂ ι : Type*}
   285	        [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype Y₁] [DecidableEq Y₁]
   286	        [Fintype Y₂] [DecidableEq Y₂] [Fintype R₁] [DecidableEq R₁]
   287	        [Fintype R₂] [DecidableEq R₂]
   288	        [Fintype Γ₁] [DecidableEq Γ₁] [Fintype Γ₂] [DecidableEq Γ₂]
   289	        [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   290	        (D : Distribution ((X × Y₁) × Y₂))
   291	        (eval₁ : Γ₁ → Y₁ → R₁) (eval₂ : Γ₂ → Y₂ → R₂)
   292	        (G₁ : X → Measurement Γ₁ ι) (G₂ : X → Measurement Γ₂ ι)
   293	        (A : ((X × Y₁) × Y₂) → Measurement (R₁ × R₂) ι)
   294	        (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ι × ι)) (η δ : ℝ),
   295	        D.IsProbability → ‖ψ‖ = 1 → 0 ≤ η → 0 ≤ δ →
   296	        (∀ x, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (G₂ x)) →
   297	        (∀ q, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (A q)) →
   298	        HasConditionalCollisionBound D eval₂ η →
   299	        consistencyDefect D
   300	          (fun q a₁ => heteroKron (((A q).postprocess Prod.fst).effect a₁) 1)
   301	          (fun q a₁ => heteroKron 1 (((G₁ q.1.1).postprocess
   302	            (fun g => eval₁ g q.1.2)).effect a₁)) ψ ≤ δ →
   303	        consistencyDefect D
   304	          (fun q a₂ => heteroKron (((A q).postprocess Prod.snd).effect a₂) 1)
   305	          (fun q a₂ => heteroKron 1 (((G₂ q.1.1).postprocess
   306	            (fun g => eval₂ g q.2)).effect a₂)) ψ ≤ δ →
   307	        consistencyDefect D (fun q a => heteroKron ((A q).effect a) 1)
   308	          (fun q a => heteroKron 1 ((A q).effect a)) ψ ≤ δ →
   309	        consistencyDefect D (fun q a => heteroKron ((A q).effect a) 1)
   310	          (fun q a => heteroKron 1 (∑ g₁ : Γ₁, ∑ g₂ : Γ₂,
   311	            if (eval₁ g₁ q.1.2, eval₂ g₂ q.2) = a then
   312	              pastedMeasurement (fun g => (G₁ q.1.1).effect g)
   313	                (fun g => (G₂ q.1.1).effect g) g₁ g₂ else 0)) ψ ≤ δp η δ := by
   314	  sorry

    29	/-- View the coordinate function of an LDT pure state as a Euclidean vector. -/
    30	noncomputable def pureStateEuclideanVector
    31	    {iota : Type*} [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota] [Nonempty iota]
    32	    (psi : PureState iota) : EuclideanSpace ℂ iota :=
    33	  (EuclideanSpace.equiv iota ℂ).symm psi.vector
    34	
    35	@[simp] theorem pureStateEuclideanVector_apply
    36	    {iota : Type*} [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota] [Nonempty iota]
    37	    (psi : PureState iota) (i : iota) :
    38	    pureStateEuclideanVector psi i = psi.vector i :=
    39	  rfl
    40	
    41	/-- The Euclidean vector associated with an LDT pure state has norm one. -/
    42	theorem pureStateEuclideanVector_norm
    43	    {iota : Type*} [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota] [Nonempty iota]
    44	    (psi : PureState iota) : ‖pureStateEuclideanVector psi‖ = 1 := by
    45	  have hsquareComplex :
    46	      ((‖pureStateEuclideanVector psi‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) = 1 := by
    47	    calc
    48	      ((‖pureStateEuclideanVector psi‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) =
    49	          (‖pureStateEuclideanVector psi‖ : ℂ) ^ 2 := by norm_cast
    50	      _ = inner ℂ (pureStateEuclideanVector psi)
    51	          (pureStateEuclideanVector psi) :=
    52	        (inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K (pureStateEuclideanVector psi)).symm
    53	      _ = dotProduct psi.vector (star psi.vector) :=
    54	        EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct _ _
    55	      _ = dotProduct (star psi.vector) psi.vector := dotProduct_comm _ _
    56	      _ = 1 := psi.unit
    57	  have hsquare : ‖pureStateEuclideanVector psi‖ ^ 2 = (1 : ℝ) := by
    58	    exact_mod_cast hsquareComplex
    59	  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (pureStateEuclideanVector psi)]
    60	
    61	/-- Evaluation in a pure LDT density state is the quadratic form of its
    62	Euclidean vector. -/
    63	theorem pureState_stateQForm_eq_ev
    64	    {iota : Type*} [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota] [Nonempty iota]
    65	    (psi : PureState iota) (T : Op iota) :
    66	    DistanceCalculus.stateQForm (pureStateEuclideanVector psi) T =
    67	      ev (psi : QuantumState iota) T := by
    68	  rw [PureState.ev_eq_re_inner]
    69	  unfold DistanceCalculus.stateQForm applyOperatorToState
    70	  change (inner ℂ (pureStateEuclideanVector psi)
    71	      (WithLp.toLp 2 (T *ᵥ psi.vector))).re =
    72	    (dotProduct (star psi.vector) (T *ᵥ psi.vector)).re
    73	  rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct, dotProduct_comm]
    74	  rfl
    75	
    76	/-- For complete projective families and a pure bipartite state, the mature
    77	LDT consistency relation is exactly the QPBT off-diagonal defect.  In
    78	particular, changing between the density and vector formulations incurs no
    79	loss in the error parameter. -/
    80	theorem consRel_iff_consistencyDefect
    81	    {Question Outcome iotaA iotaB : Type*}
    82	    [Fintype Question] [DecidableEq Question]
    83	    [Fintype Outcome] [DecidableEq Outcome]
    84	    [Fintype iotaA] [DecidableEq iotaA]
    85	    [Fintype iotaB] [DecidableEq iotaB]
    86	    [Nonempty (iotaA × iotaB)]
    87	    (psi : PureState (iotaA × iotaB))
    88	    (mu : Distribution Question) (hmu : mu.IsProbability)
    89	    (A : Question → ProjMeas Outcome iotaA)
    90	    (B : Question → ProjMeas Outcome iotaB) (delta : ℝ) :
    91	    ConsRel (psi : QuantumState (iotaA × iotaB)) mu
    92	        (fun x => (A x).toSubMeas) (fun x => (B x).toSubMeas) delta ↔
    93	      consistencyDefect mu
    94	        (fun x a => heteroKron ((A x).outcome a) 1)
    95	        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((B x).outcome a))
    96	        (pureStateEuclideanVector psi) ≤ delta := by
    97	  let AM : Question → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement Outcome (iotaA × iotaB) :=
    98	    fun x => DistanceCalculus.leftPlacedMeasurement
    99	      (ldtMeasurementToMatrixMeasurement (A x).toMeasurement)
   100	  let BM : Question → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement Outcome (iotaA × iotaB) :=
   101	    fun x => DistanceCalculus.rightPlacedMeasurement
   102	      (ldtMeasurementToMatrixMeasurement (B x).toMeasurement)
   103	  have hAM (x : Question) (a : Outcome) :
   104	      (AM x).effect a = heteroKron ((A x).outcome a) 1 := rfl
   105	  have hBM (x : Question) (a : Outcome) :
   106	      (BM x).effect a = heteroKron 1 ((B x).outcome a) := rfl
   107	  have hdefect :
   108	      consistencyDefect mu
   109	          (fun x a => heteroKron ((A x).outcome a) 1)
   110	          (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((B x).outcome a))
   111	          (pureStateEuclideanVector psi) =
   112	        bipartiteConsError (psi : QuantumState (iotaA × iotaB)) mu
   113	          (fun x => (A x).toSubMeas) (fun x => (B x).toSubMeas) := by
   114	    calc
   115	      consistencyDefect mu
   116	          (fun x a => heteroKron ((A x).outcome a) 1)
   117	          (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((B x).outcome a))
   118	          (pureStateEuclideanVector psi) =
   119	          1 - avgOver mu (fun x => ∑ a,
   120	            DistanceCalculus.stateQForm (pureStateEuclideanVector psi)
   121	              ((AM x).effect a * (BM x).effect a)) := by
   122	            simpa only [hAM, hBM] using
   123	              DistanceCalculus.consistencyDefect_eq_one_sub_overlap
   124	                mu AM BM (pureStateEuclideanVector psi) hmu
   125	                  (pureStateEuclideanVector_norm psi)
   126	      _ = avgOver mu (fun x => 1 - ∑ a,
   127	            DistanceCalculus.stateQForm (pureStateEuclideanVector psi)
   128	              ((AM x).effect a * (BM x).effect a)) := by
   129	            rw [avgOver_sub, avgOver_const_of_isProbability mu hmu]
   130	      _ = bipartiteConsError (psi : QuantumState (iotaA × iotaB)) mu
   131	          (fun x => (A x).toSubMeas) (fun x => (B x).toSubMeas) := by
   132	            unfold bipartiteConsError
   133	            apply avgOver_congr
   134	            intro x
   135	            rw [qBipartiteConsDefect_of_measurements
   136	              (psi : QuantumState (iotaA × iotaB))
   137	              (A x).toMeasurement (B x).toMeasurement]
   138	            rw [ev_one_of_isNormalized (psi : QuantumState (iotaA × iotaB))
   139	              psi.toQuantumState_isNormalized]
   140	            congr 1
   141	            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   142	            intro a _
   143	            rw [hAM, hBM]
   144	            rw [DistanceCalculus.placed_product_stateQForm_eq]
   145	            exact pureState_stateQForm_eq_ev psi
   146	              (opTensor ((A x).outcome a) ((B x).outcome a))
   147	  constructor
   148	  · intro h
   149	    rw [hdefect]
   150	    exact h.offDiagonalBound
   151	  · intro h
   152	    refine ⟨?_⟩
   153	    rw [← hdefect]
   154	    exact h

   214	theorem strategyConsRel_consistencyDefect_le
   215	    {G : Game} (S : Strategy G)
   216	    {Question Outcome : Type*}
   217	    [Fintype Question] [DecidableEq Question]
   218	    [Fintype Outcome] [DecidableEq Outcome]
   219	    (mu : Distribution Question) (hmu : mu.IsProbability)
   220	    (A : Question → ProjMeas Outcome S.ιA)
   221	    (B : Question → ProjMeas Outcome S.ιB) (delta : ℝ)
   222	    (h : ConsRel (strategyQuantumState S) mu
   223	      (fun x => (A x).toSubMeas) (fun x => (B x).toSubMeas) delta) :

   225	      (fun x a => heteroKron ((A x).outcome a) 1)

     9	/-!
    10	# The directly indexed low-degree game
    11	
    12	The low-degree game used by the Pauli-basis combining argument is needed in
    13	dimension `2 * m + 2`.  The existing conditionally linear game represents a
    14	coordinate index by an equally sized fiber in the scalar field and therefore
    15	requires the dimension to divide the field size.  This file gives the separate
    16	directly indexed variant which samples that index directly.
    17	
    18	The geometric line carrier records the sampled coordinate, and line evaluation
    19	uses an `Option` outcome rather than assigning a value when a point does not
    20	determine one.  The game retains the point, axis-line, and diagonal-line answer
    21	formats and the nine ordered type branches of the original low-degree game.
    22	
    23	The `Transport` modules relate the direct game to the seed-indexed game and to
    24	the mature low individual degree test interface: `Transport.Correspondence`
    25	identifies coordinates, answers, and the question law of the two QPBT
    26	presentations; `Transport.SeedFiber` dilates a seed-indexed strategy to a
    27	direct strategy by a correlated residue register, and `Transport.SeedFiberValue`
    28	shows that the dilation preserves the value exactly; `Transport.Questions`
    29	reads mature lines as canonical direct questions and rebases direct answers;
    30	`Transport.Strategy` reads one coordinate of a projective direct strategy as a
    31	mature `ProjStrat`, with exact Born-weight formulas for both adapters; and
    32	`Transport.BranchComparison`, `Transport.DiagonalRecursion`, and
    33	`Transport.PassConversion` convert a value bound of the direct game into the
    34	pass hypothesis of the mature low individual degree theorem for every
    35	coordinate strategy.  `GameValue` supplies the rejection calculus relating the
    36	direct value to the mature branch weights.  `Transport.Error` carries the
    37	scalar half of the transport: the auxiliary sampling parameter with which
    38	the mature theorem is applied, bounds on the three terms of its error
    39	function, and the absorption of the resulting simultaneous-measurement
    40	estimate into the error function of `lem:ld-soundness`.
    41	`Transport.Consistency` identifies polynomial outcomes and transports the
    42	three mature consistency conclusions to the direct game.
    43	
    44	## References
    45	
    46	The underlying game is `def:ld-game` in
    47	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-105`, with source origin
    48	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
    49	The need for the directly indexed repair in Chapter 15 is explained around
    50	`rem:qld-4-7-divisibility` in
    51	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:1257-1293` and in
    52	`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`.
    53	-/

    32	    (D : DirectLdParams) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin D.m) (DirectScalarQ D))
    33	    (hp : ∀ i, MvPolynomial.degreeOf i p ≤ D.d) (i : Fin D.m) :
    34	    MvPolynomial.degreeOf i (MvPolynomial.rename Fin.rev p) ≤ D.d := by

    39	private theorem ldtPolynomial_ext
    40	    {params : Parameters} [FieldModel params.q]
    41	    {g h : MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial params} (hpoly : g.poly = h.poly) : g = h := by
    42	  cases g with
    43	  | mk gp hg =>
    44	      cases h with
    45	      | mk hp hh =>
    46	          simp only at hpoly
    47	          subst hp

    50	/-- Bounded QPBT polynomial representatives are equivalent to mature LDT
    51	polynomial outcomes.  The variable renaming is the same coordinate reversal
    52	as `directPointEquiv`, so evaluation retains the direct coordinate order. -/
    53	noncomputable def directPolyEquivPolynomial (D : DirectLdParams) :
    54	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    55	    PolyIndex D.m (DirectScalarQ D) D.d ≃
    56	      MIPStarRE.LDT.Polynomial D.toLDTParameters := by
    57	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
    58	  refine
    59	    { toFun := fun g =>
    60	        { poly := MvPolynomial.rename Fin.rev g.1
    61	          lowIndividualDegree := directPolynomialRename_degreeOf_le D g.1
    62	            (degreeOf_le_of_mem_polyFunc g.2) }
    63	      invFun := fun g =>
    64	        ⟨MvPolynomial.rename Fin.rev g.poly, ?_⟩
    65	      left_inv := ?_
    66	      right_inv := ?_ }
    67	  · rw [MvPolynomial.mem_restrictDegree]
    68	    intro s hs i
    69	    exact (MvPolynomial.degreeOf_le_iff.mp
    70	      (directPolynomialRename_degreeOf_le D g.poly g.lowIndividualDegree i)) s hs
    71	  · intro g
    72	    apply Subtype.ext
    73	    change MvPolynomial.rename Fin.rev
    74	      (MvPolynomial.rename Fin.rev g.1) = g.1
    75	    rw [MvPolynomial.rename_rename]
    76	    rw [show Fin.rev ∘ Fin.rev = id by funext i; simp]
    77	    exact MvPolynomial.rename_id_apply g.1
    78	  · intro g
    79	    cases g with
    80	    | mk p hp =>
    81	        have hpoly : MvPolynomial.rename Fin.rev
    82	            (MvPolynomial.rename Fin.rev p) = p := by
    83	          rw [MvPolynomial.rename_rename]
    84	          rw [show Fin.rev ∘ Fin.rev = id by funext i; simp]
    85	          exact MvPolynomial.rename_id_apply p
    86	        apply ldtPolynomial_ext
    87	        exact hpoly

   120	measurement, with exactly the same effects. -/
   121	noncomputable def ldtMeasurementToMatrixMeasurement
   122	    {alpha iota : Type*} [Fintype alpha] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   123	    (M : MIPStarRE.LDT.Measurement alpha iota) :
   124	    MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota :=
   125	  MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne M.outcome M.outcome_pos (by
   126	    rw [M.sum_eq_total, M.total_eq_one])

   129	    {alpha iota : Type*} [Fintype alpha] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   130	    (M : MIPStarRE.LDT.Measurement alpha iota) (a : alpha) :
   131	    (ldtMeasurementToMatrixMeasurement M).effect a = M.outcome a :=
   132	  rfl

   134	private theorem matrixMeasurement_ext
   135	    {alpha iota : Type*} [Fintype alpha] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   136	    {M N : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota}
   137	    (h : ∀ a, M.effect a = N.effect a) : M = N := by
   138	  cases M with
   139	  | mk M hM =>
   140	      cases N with
   141	      | mk N hN =>
   142	          cases M with
   143	          | mk effectM posM leM =>
   144	              cases N with
   145	              | mk effectN posN leN =>
   146	                  simp only at h
   147	                  have heffect : effectM = effectN := funext h
   148	                  subst effectN
   149	                  rfl

   151	/-- Postprocessing matrix-valued measurements is functorial. -/
   152	theorem matrixMeasurement_postprocess_comp
   153	    {alpha beta gamma iota : Type*}
   154	    [Fintype alpha] [DecidableEq alpha]
   155	    [Fintype beta] [DecidableEq beta]
   156	    [Fintype gamma] [DecidableEq gamma]
   157	    [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   158	    (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota)
   159	    (f : alpha → beta) (g : beta → gamma) :
   160	    (M.postprocess f).postprocess g = M.postprocess (fun a => g (f a)) := by
   161	  classical
   162	  apply matrixMeasurement_ext
   163	  intro c
   164	  calc
   165	    ((M.postprocess f).postprocess g).effect c =
   166	        ∑ b : beta, if g b = c then
   167	          ∑ a : alpha, if f a = b then M.effect a else 0
   168	        else 0 := by
   169	          change (∑ b ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun b : beta => g b = c),
   170	            ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a : alpha => f a = b), M.effect a) = _
   171	          rw [Finset.sum_filter]
   172	          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   173	          intro b _
   174	          by_cases hgb : g b = c
   175	          · simp only [hgb, if_true]
   176	            rw [Finset.sum_filter]
   177	          · simp [hgb]
   178	    _ = ∑ b : beta, ∑ a : alpha,
   179	        if g b = c ∧ f a = b then M.effect a else 0 := by
   180	          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   181	          intro b _
   182	          by_cases hgc : g b = c <;> simp [hgc]
   183	    _ = ∑ a : alpha, ∑ b : beta,
   184	        if g b = c ∧ f a = b then M.effect a else 0 := by
   185	          rw [Finset.sum_comm]
   186	    _ = ∑ a : alpha,
   187	        if g (f a) = c then M.effect a else 0 := by
   188	          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   189	          intro a _
   190	          by_cases hgc : g (f a) = c
   191	          · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (f a)]
   192	            · simp [hgc]
   193	            · intro b _ hba
   194	              by_cases hfa : f a = b
   195	              · exact (hba hfa.symm).elim
   196	              · simp [hfa]
   197	            · simp
   198	          · have hzero :
   199	                (∑ b : beta,
   200	                  if g b = c ∧ f a = b then M.effect a else 0) = 0 := by
   201	              apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
   202	              intro b _
   203	              by_cases hfa : f a = b
   204	              · subst b
   205	                simp [hgc]
   206	              · simp [hfa]
   207	            simp [hgc, hzero]
   208	    _ = (M.postprocess (fun a => g (f a))).effect c := by
   209	          change _ = ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter
   210	            (fun a : alpha => g (f a) = c), M.effect a
   211	          rw [Finset.sum_filter]

    38	    Point params ≃ (Fin params.m → Scalar params) where
    39	  toFun := decodePoint
    40	  invFun := fun u i => encodeScalar (u i)

    44	/-- Reindex evaluation equality from coded `Point params` points to the scalar

    46	lemma polynomialAgreement_avg_eq_scalarDomain
    47	    (params : Parameters) [FieldModel params.q]
    48	    (g g' : Polynomial params) :
    49	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Point params))
    50	      (fun u => if g u = g' u then (1 : Error) else 0) =
    51	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin params.m → Scalar params))
    52	        (fun u =>
    53	          if MvPolynomial.eval u g.poly = MvPolynomial.eval u g'.poly then
    54	            (1 : Error)
    55	          else 0) := by
    56	  let e := pointScalarEquiv params
    57	  calc
    58	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Point params))
    59	        (fun u => if g u = g' u then (1 : Error) else 0)
    60	      = avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin params.m → Scalar params))
    61	          (fun u => if g (e.symm u) = g' (e.symm u) then (1 : Error) else 0) := by
    62	            simpa [e] using
    63	              (avgOver_uniform_equiv e
    64	                (fun u : Point params => if g u = g' u then (1 : Error) else 0))
    65	    _ = avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin params.m → Scalar params))
    66	          (fun u =>
    67	            if MvPolynomial.eval u g.poly = MvPolynomial.eval u g'.poly then
    68	              (1 : Error)
    69	            else 0) := by
    70	            apply avgOver_congr
    71	            intro u
    72	            have hdecode : decodePoint (e.symm u) = u := by
    73	              simpa [e, pointScalarEquiv] using e.right_inv u
    74	            by_cases hEval : MvPolynomial.eval u g.poly = MvPolynomial.eval u g'.poly

    76	                change encodeScalar (MvPolynomial.eval (decodePoint (e.symm u)) g.poly) =
    77	                  encodeScalar (MvPolynomial.eval (decodePoint (e.symm u)) g'.poly)
    78	                congr 1
    79	                simpa [hdecode] using hEval
    80	              simp [hEval, hPointEval]
    81	            · have hPointEval : ¬ g (e.symm u) = g' (e.symm u) := by
    82	                intro hEq
    83	                apply hEval
    84	                apply (FieldModel.equiv (q := params.q)).injective

    86	                  encodeScalar (MvPolynomial.eval (decodePoint (e.symm u)) g'.poly) at hEq

    90	/-- Schwartz-Zippel bound for the pointwise agreement indicator of two distinct
    91	full polynomial outcomes.
    92	
    93	Packages the `md/q` loss term that appears at:
    94	- `references/ldt-paper/inductive_step.tex` lines 119–133 (the `mainFormal`
    95	  Step 5 self-consistency cascade, issue #425),
    96	- `references/ldt-paper/commutativity-G.tex` (the `comMain` step, issue #297).

    98	Both call sites previously held a private duplicate of this proof; this is the
    99	shared, reusable form. -/
   100	lemma polynomialAgreement_avg_le_mdq
   101	    (params : Parameters) [FieldModel params.q]
   102	    (g g' : Polynomial params) (hneq : g ≠ g') :
   103	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Point params))
   104	      (fun u => if g u = g' u then (1 : Error) else 0) ≤
   105	      (params.m * params.d : Error) / params.q := by
   106	  classical
   107	  let gLow : polyFunc params.m (Scalar params) params.d :=
   108	    ⟨g.poly, by
   109	      rw [MvPolynomial.mem_restrictDegree_iff_sup]
   110	      simpa [MvPolynomial.degreeOf_def] using g.lowIndividualDegree⟩
   111	  let g'Low : polyFunc params.m (Scalar params) params.d :=
   112	    ⟨g'.poly, by
   113	      rw [MvPolynomial.mem_restrictDegree_iff_sup]
   114	      simpa [MvPolynomial.degreeOf_def] using g'.lowIndividualDegree⟩
   115	  have hneqLow : gLow ≠ g'Low := by
   116	    intro hEq
   117	    have hpoly : g.poly = g'.poly := congrArg Subtype.val hEq
   118	    apply hneq
   119	    cases g
   120	    cases g'
   121	    cases hpoly
   122	    rfl
   123	  have hsz := schwartzZippel_individualDegree gLow g'Low hneqLow
   124	  have havg_scalar :
   125	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin params.m → Scalar params))
   126	        (fun u =>
   127	          if MvPolynomial.eval u g.poly = MvPolynomial.eval u g'.poly then
   128	            (1 : Error)
   129	          else 0) =
   130	      (polynomialAgreementProbability
   131	        params.m (Scalar params) g.poly g'.poly : Error) := by
   132	    calc
   133	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin params.m → Scalar params))
   134	          (fun u =>
   135	            if MvPolynomial.eval u g.poly = MvPolynomial.eval u g'.poly then
   136	              (1 : Error)
   137	            else 0)
   138	        = ∑ u : Fin params.m → Scalar params,
   139	            if MvPolynomial.eval u g.poly = MvPolynomial.eval u g'.poly then
   140	              (Fintype.card (Scalar params) ^ params.m : Error)⁻¹
   141	            else 0 := by
   142	              simp [avgOver, uniformDistribution]
   143	      _ = Finset.sum
   144	            ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin params.m → Scalar params)).filter
   145	              (fun u => MvPolynomial.eval u g.poly = MvPolynomial.eval u g'.poly))
   146	            (fun _ => (Fintype.card (Scalar params) ^ params.m : Error)⁻¹) := by
   147	              rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
   148	      _ = (((Finset.univ.filter fun u : Fin params.m → Scalar params =>
   149	              MvPolynomial.eval u g.poly = MvPolynomial.eval u g'.poly).card : ℕ) : Error) *
   150	            (Fintype.card (Scalar params) ^ params.m : Error)⁻¹ := by
   151	              simp
   152	      _ = (polynomialAgreementProbability
   153	            params.m (Scalar params) g.poly g'.poly : Error) := by
   154	              simp [polynomialAgreementProbability, div_eq_mul_inv]
   155	  calc
   156	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Point params))
   157	        (fun u => if g u = g' u then (1 : Error) else 0)
   158	      = avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin params.m → Scalar params))
   159	          (fun u =>
   160	            if MvPolynomial.eval u g.poly = MvPolynomial.eval u g'.poly then
   161	              (1 : Error)
   162	            else 0) :=
   163	            polynomialAgreement_avg_eq_scalarDomain params g g'
   164	    _ = (polynomialAgreementProbability
   165	          params.m (Scalar params) g.poly g'.poly : Error) :=
   166	          havg_scalar
   167	    _ ≤ ((((params.m * params.d : ℕ) : ℚ≥0) / Fintype.card (Scalar params)) : Error) := by
   168	          exact_mod_cast hsz
   169	    _ = (params.m * params.d : Error) / params.q := by
   170	          simp [div_eq_mul_inv]

    25	/-- Formalization-only definition used in the proof of Fact 4.26: place a
    26	complete measurement on the left tensor factor. -/
    27	noncomputable def leftPlacedMeasurement {α ιA ιB : Type*}
    28	    [Fintype α] [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA]
    29	    [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
    30	    (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α ιA) :
    31	    MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α (ιA × ιB) :=
    32	  MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne
    33	    (fun a => heteroKron (M.effect a) 1)
    34	    (fun a => MIPStarRE.Quantum.kronecker_nonneg (M.pos a)
    35	      (Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg : 0 ≤ (1 : Op ιB)))
    36	    (by
    37	      change ∑ a : α, leftTensor (ι₂ := ιB) (M.effect a) = 1
    38	      rw [leftTensor_finset_sum, M.sum_eq_one, leftTensor_one])
    39	
    40	/-- Formalization-only definition used in the proof of Fact 4.26: place a
    41	complete measurement on the right tensor factor. -/
    42	noncomputable def rightPlacedMeasurement {α ιA ιB : Type*}
    43	    [Fintype α] [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA]
    44	    [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
    45	    (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α ιB) :
    46	    MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α (ιA × ιB) :=
    47	  MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne
    48	    (fun a => heteroKron 1 (M.effect a))
    49	    (fun a => MIPStarRE.Quantum.kronecker_nonneg
    50	      (Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg : 0 ≤ (1 : Op ιA)) (M.pos a))
    51	    (by
    52	      change ∑ a : α, rightTensor (ι₁ := ιA) (M.effect a) = 1
    53	      rw [rightTensor_finset_sum, M.sum_eq_one, rightTensor_one])

    76	/-- Evaluation in the rank-one vector state is the corresponding quadratic form. -/

    80	    ev (vectorQuantumState ψ) T = stateQForm ψ T := by

    89	      ((T *ᵥ ψ.ofLp) ⬝ᵥ star ψ.ofLp)) /

    92	  unfold stateQForm applyOperatorToState

    98	theorem diagonal_postprocess_stateQForm_ge {α β ιA ιB : Type*}

   107	      ∑ a : α, stateQForm ψ (heteroKron (A.effect a) (B.effect a)) := by
   108	  classical
   109	  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty (ιA × ιB) with
   110	  | inl hι =>
   111	      letI := hι
   112	      have hψ : ψ = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
   113	      subst ψ
   114	      simp [stateQForm, applyOperatorToState]
   115	  | inr hι =>
   116	      letI := hι
   117	      letI : Nonempty ιA := ⟨(Classical.choice hι).1⟩
   118	      letI : Nonempty ιB := ⟨(Classical.choice hι).2⟩
   119	      let HA : FiniteHilbertSpace :=
   120	        { carrier := ιA
   121	          instFintype := inferInstance
   122	          instDecidableEq := inferInstance
   123	          instNonempty := inferInstance }

   125	        { carrier := ιB
   126	          instFintype := inferInstance
   127	          instDecidableEq := inferInstance
   128	          instNonempty := inferInstance }

   131	      let Bs : SubMeas α ιB :=
   132	        (MatrixMeasurement.toMeasurement (H := HB) B).toSubMeas

   161	/-- Squared effects in one measurement fiber sum to at most the identity. -/

   163	    [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   164	    (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (α × β) ι) (a : α) :
   165	    ∑ b : β, (M.effect (a, b))ᴴ * M.effect (a, b) ≤ 1 := by
   166	  classical

/-! # Sandwiched measurements and pasting

This module defines the ordered palindromic products used to combine
measurements and records the two quantitative consistency statements imported
by the QPBT analysis.

## References

The source results are `lem:ld-sandwich` and `lem:pasting` in
`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:398-469`, with paper origin
`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:465-525`.
-/

open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder Matrix ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open MIPStarRE.Quantum

/-- The ordered product
`G^k_{g_k} ... G^1_{g_1} ... G^k_{g_k}` of `lem:ld-sandwich`.

**Local fix:** The source reverses the outcome indices, which is ill-typed when
the outcome families differ. This definition uses the pairing corrected in
`rem:ld-sandwich-indexing` and
`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-sandwich-indexing.tex`; blueprint statement
`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:398-425` and remark `ch12_qpbt_games.tex:430-432`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:465-501`. Tracked in
issue #16. The empty product is `1`. -/
noncomputable def sandwichProduct {k : ℕ} {X ι : Type*}
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {Γ : Fin k → Type*}
    (G : (i : Fin k) → X → Γ i → Op ι) (x : X)
    (g : (i : Fin k) → Γ i) : Op ι :=
  let operators := List.ofFn (fun i : Fin k => G i x (g i))
  operators.reverse.prod * operators.tail.prod

/-- The two-family sandwiched product
`(G₂)_{g₂} (G₁)_{g₁} (G₂)_{g₂}` from `eq:pasting-2a`; blueprint
`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:442-469`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:504-525`. -/
def pastedMeasurement {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {G₁ G₂ : Type*} (M₁ : G₁ → Op ι) (M₂ : G₂ → Op ι)
    (g₁ : G₁) (g₂ : G₂) : Op ι :=
  M₂ g₂ * M₁ g₁ * M₂ g₂

/-- Evaluating a tuple of codewords at a common point. This is a
formalization-only auxiliary for `lem:ld-sandwich`, blueprint
`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:398-425`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:465-495`. -/
def evalFunctionTuple {k : ℕ} {Y : Type*} {R Γ : Fin k → Type*}
    (eval : (i : Fin k) → Γ i → Y → R i) (y : Y)
    (g : (i : Fin k) → Γ i) : (i : Fin k) → R i :=
  fun i => eval i (g i) y

/-- The palindromic effects form a POVM when each constituent measurement is
projective. This is the measurement assertion implicit in `lem:ld-sandwich`,
blueprint `ch12_qpbt_games.tex:415-425`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:484-494`. -/
theorem sandwichProduct_isMeasurement {k : ℕ} {X ι : Type*}
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {Γ : Fin k → Type*}
    [∀ i, Fintype (Γ i)] (G : (i : Fin k) → X → Measurement (Γ i) ι)
    (hG : ∀ i x, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (G i x)) (x : X) :
    (∀ g : (i : Fin k) → Γ i,
      0 ≤ sandwichProduct (fun i x' a => (G i x').effect a) x g) ∧
      (∑ g : (i : Fin k) → Γ i,
        sandwichProduct (fun i x' a => (G i x').effect a) x g) = 1 := by
  sorry

/-- The sandwiched simultaneous-measurement estimate of `lem:ld-sandwich`.
One universal asymptotic constant applies independently of the distribution,
measurements, state, and error parameters. Blueprint
`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:398-425`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:465-501`. -/
theorem consistencyDefect_sandwich_le :
    ∃ C₀ : ℝ, 1 ≤ C₀ ∧
      ∀ {k : ℕ} {X Y ιA ιB : Type*} {R Γ : Fin k → Type*}
        [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype Y] [DecidableEq Y] [Nonempty Y]
        [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
        [∀ i, Fintype (R i)] [∀ i, DecidableEq (R i)]
        [∀ i, Fintype (Γ i)] [∀ i, DecidableEq (Γ i)]
        (μ : Distribution X)
        (eval : (i : Fin k) → Γ i → Y → R i)
        (G : (i : Fin k) → X → Measurement (Γ i) ιB)
        (A : X → Measurement ((i : Fin k) → Γ i) ιA)
        (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (ε δ : ℝ),
      μ.IsProbability → ‖ψ‖ = 1 → 0 < ε → 0 ≤ δ →
      (∀ i x, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (G i x)) →
      (∀ x, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (A x)) →
      (∀ i (g g' : Γ i), g ≠ g' →
        avgOver (uniformDistribution Y)
          (fun y => if eval i g y = eval i g' y then 1 else 0) ≤ ε) →
      (∀ i, consistencyDefect (Distribution.prod μ (uniformDistribution Y))
        (fun xy a => heteroKron (((A xy.1).postprocess
          (fun g => eval i (g i) xy.2)).effect a) 1)
        (fun xy a => heteroKron 1 (((G i xy.1).postprocess
          (fun g => eval i g xy.2)).effect a)) ψ ≤ δ) →
      consistencyDefect (Distribution.prod μ (uniformDistribution Y))
        (fun xy a => heteroKron (((A xy.1).postprocess
          (evalFunctionTuple eval xy.2)).effect a) 1)
        (fun xy a => heteroKron 1 (∑ g : (i : Fin k) → Γ i,
          if evalFunctionTuple eval xy.2 g = a then
            sandwichProduct (fun i x h => (G i x).effect h) xy.1 g else 0)) ψ ≤
        C₀ * (k : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (δ + ε) := by
  sorry

/-- The positive-mass conditional collision bound used by `lem:pasting`.
This is a formalization-only spelling of the conditional probability in
`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:442-469`, with paper origin
`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:504-525`. -/
def HasConditionalCollisionBound {X Y₁ Y₂ R₂ Γ₂ : Type*}
    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype Y₁] [DecidableEq Y₁]
    [Fintype Y₂] [DecidableEq Y₂] [Fintype R₂] [DecidableEq R₂]
    [Fintype Γ₂]
    (D : Distribution ((X × Y₁) × Y₂)) (eval₂ : Γ₂ → Y₂ → R₂)
    (η : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ x y₁, 0 < (D.map Prod.fst).weight (x, y₁) →
    ∀ g g' : Γ₂, g ≠ g' →
      (∑ y₂ : Y₂, D.weight ((x, y₁), y₂) *
        if eval₂ g y₂ = eval₂ g' y₂ then 1 else 0) ≤
        η * (D.map Prod.fst).weight (x, y₁)

/-- The effects obtained by sandwiching one measurement with a projective
measurement form a POVM. This is the measurement assertion for
`eq:pasting-2a`, blueprint `ch12_qpbt_games.tex:456-459`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:514-524`. -/
theorem pastedMeasurement_isMeasurement {Γ₁ Γ₂ ι : Type*}
    [Fintype Γ₁] [Fintype Γ₂] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (G₁ : Measurement Γ₁ ι) (G₂ : Measurement Γ₂ ι)
    (hG₂ : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective G₂) :
    (∀ g : Γ₁ × Γ₂,
      0 ≤ pastedMeasurement G₁.effect G₂.effect g.1 g.2) ∧
      (∑ g : Γ₁ × Γ₂,
        pastedMeasurement G₁.effect G₂.effect g.1 g.2) = 1 := by
  sorry

/-- Pasting two consistent measurements yields a product-form polynomial
error. All operator families in the conclusion are the postprocessed source
families. This is `lem:pasting`, blueprint `ch12_qpbt_games.tex:442-469`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:504-525`. -/
theorem exists_pasting_error :
    ∃ δp : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, IsPolyErr₂ δp ∧
      ∀ {X Y₁ Y₂ R₁ R₂ Γ₁ Γ₂ ι : Type*}
        [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype Y₁] [DecidableEq Y₁]
        [Fintype Y₂] [DecidableEq Y₂] [Fintype R₁] [DecidableEq R₁]
        [Fintype R₂] [DecidableEq R₂]
        [Fintype Γ₁] [DecidableEq Γ₁] [Fintype Γ₂] [DecidableEq Γ₂]
        [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
        (D : Distribution ((X × Y₁) × Y₂))
        (eval₁ : Γ₁ → Y₁ → R₁) (eval₂ : Γ₂ → Y₂ → R₂)
        (G₁ : X → Measurement Γ₁ ι) (G₂ : X → Measurement Γ₂ ι)
        (A : ((X × Y₁) × Y₂) → Measurement (R₁ × R₂) ι)
        (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ι × ι)) (η δ : ℝ),
        D.IsProbability → ‖ψ‖ = 1 → 0 ≤ η → 0 ≤ δ →
        (∀ x, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (G₂ x)) →
        (∀ q, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (A q)) →
        HasConditionalCollisionBound D eval₂ η →
        consistencyDefect D
          (fun q a₁ => heteroKron (((A q).postprocess Prod.fst).effect a₁) 1)
          (fun q a₁ => heteroKron 1 (((G₁ q.1.1).postprocess
            (fun g => eval₁ g q.1.2)).effect a₁)) ψ ≤ δ →
        consistencyDefect D
          (fun q a₂ => heteroKron (((A q).postprocess Prod.snd).effect a₂) 1)
          (fun q a₂ => heteroKron 1 (((G₂ q.1.1).postprocess
            (fun g => eval₂ g q.2)).effect a₂)) ψ ≤ δ →
        consistencyDefect D (fun q a => heteroKron ((A q).effect a) 1)
          (fun q a => heteroKron 1 ((A q).effect a)) ψ ≤ δ →
        consistencyDefect D (fun q a => heteroKron ((A q).effect a) 1)
          (fun q a => heteroKron 1 (∑ g₁ : Γ₁, ∑ g₂ : Γ₂,
            if (eval₁ g₁ q.1.2, eval₂ g₂ q.2) = a then
              pastedMeasurement (fun g => (G₁ q.1.1).effect g)
                (fun g => (G₂ q.1.1).effect g) g₁ g₂ else 0)) ψ ≤ δp η δ := by
  sorry

end MIPStarRE.QPBT

This module defines the ordered palindromic products used to combine

by the QPBT analysis.

## References

The source results are `lem:ld-sandwich` and `lem:pasting` in
`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:398-469`, with paper origin

open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder Matrix ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open MIPStarRE.Quantum

/-- Recursive form of the palindromic operator product, extending a tuple by
placing its final operator on both sides of the preceding product. -/
private noncomputable def sandwichProductCore {ι : Type*}
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] :
    (k : ℕ) → (Γ : Fin k → Type*) →
      ((i : Fin k) → Γ i → Op ι) → ((i : Fin k) → Γ i) → Op ι
  | 0, _, _, _ => 1
  | 1, _, G, g => G 0 (g 0)
  | k + 2, Γ, G, g =>
      G (Fin.last (k + 1)) (g (Fin.last (k + 1))) *
        sandwichProductCore (k + 1) (fun i => Γ i.castSucc)
          (fun i a => G i.castSucc a) (fun i => g i.castSucc) *
        G (Fin.last (k + 1)) (g (Fin.last (k + 1)))

/-- The ordered product
`G^k_{g_k} ... G^1_{g_1} ... G^k_{g_k}` of `lem:ld-sandwich`.

**Local fix:** The source reverses the outcome indices, which is ill-typed when
the outcome families differ. This definition uses the pairing corrected in
`rem:ld-sandwich-indexing` and
`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-sandwich-indexing.tex`; blueprint statement
`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:398-425` and remark `ch12_qpbt_games.tex:430-432`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:465-501`. Tracked in
issue #16. The empty product is `1`. -/
noncomputable def sandwichProduct {k : ℕ} {X ι : Type*}
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {Γ : Fin k → Type*}
    (G : (i : Fin k) → X → Γ i → Op ι) (x : X)
    (g : (i : Fin k) → Γ i) : Op ι :=
  sandwichProductCore k Γ (fun i a => G i x a) g

/-- The two-family sandwiched product
`(G₂)_{g₂} (G₁)_{g₁} (G₂)_{g₂}` from `eq:pasting-2a`; blueprint
`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:442-469`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:504-525`. -/
def pastedMeasurement {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {G₁ G₂ : Type*} (M₁ : G₁ → Op ι) (M₂ : G₂ → Op ι)
    (g₁ : G₁) (g₂ : G₂) : Op ι :=
  M₂ g₂ * M₁ g₁ * M₂ g₂

/-- Evaluating a tuple of codewords at a common point. This is a
formalization-only auxiliary for `lem:ld-sandwich`, blueprint
`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:398-425`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:465-495`. -/
def evalFunctionTuple {k : ℕ} {Y : Type*} {R Γ : Fin k → Type*}
    (eval : (i : Fin k) → Γ i → Y → R i) (y : Y)
    (g : (i : Fin k) → Γ i) : (i : Fin k) → R i :=
  fun i => eval i (g i) y

/-- The palindromic effects form a POVM when each constituent measurement is
projective. This is the measurement assertion implicit in `lem:ld-sandwich`,
blueprint `ch12_qpbt_games.tex:415-425`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:484-494`. -/
theorem sandwichProduct_isMeasurement {k : ℕ} {X ι : Type*}
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {Γ : Fin k → Type*}
    [∀ i, Fintype (Γ i)] (G : (i : Fin k) → X → Measurement (Γ i) ι)
    (hG : ∀ i x, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (G i x)) (x : X) :
    (∀ g : (i : Fin k) → Γ i,
      0 ≤ sandwichProduct (fun i x' a => (G i x').effect a) x g) ∧
      (∑ g : (i : Fin k) → Γ i,
        sandwichProduct (fun i x' a => (G i x').effect a) x g) = 1 := by
  classical
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      constructor
      · intro g
        change 0 ≤ (1 : Op ι)
        exact Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg
      · simp [sandwichProduct, sandwichProductCore]
  | succ k ih =>
      cases k with
      | zero =>
          constructor
          · intro g
            change 0 ≤ (G 0 x).effect (g 0)
            exact (G 0 x).pos (g 0)
          · change
              (∑ g : (i : Fin 1) → Γ i,
                (G 0 x).effect (g 0)) = 1
            calc
              (∑ g : (i : Fin 1) → Γ i, (G 0 x).effect (g 0)) =
                  ∑ p : Γ 0 × ((i : Fin 0) → Γ i.castSucc),
                    (G 0 x).effect (((Fin.snocEquiv Γ) p) 0) := by
                exact Fintype.sum_equiv (Fin.snocEquiv Γ).symm _ _
                  (by intro g; rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply])
              _ = ∑ a : Γ 0, (G 0 x).effect a := by
                rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
                apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
                intro a _
                simp only [Fintype.sum_unique]
                congr 1
              _ = 1 := (G 0 x).sum_eq_one
      | succ k =>
          have hprev := ih
            (G := fun i x' => G i.castSucc x')
            (hG := fun i x' => hG i.castSucc x')
          constructor
          · intro g
            change 0 ≤
              (G (Fin.last (k + 1)) x).effect (g (Fin.last (k + 1))) *
                sandwichProductCore (k + 1) (fun i => Γ i.castSucc)
                  (fun i a => (G i.castSucc x).effect a)
                  (fun i => g i.castSucc) *
                (G (Fin.last (k + 1)) x).effect (g (Fin.last (k + 1)))
            have hinner := hprev.1 (fun i => g i.castSucc)
            apply Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mpr
            have hpos :
                (((G (Fin.last (k + 1)) x).effect (g (Fin.last (k + 1))))ᴴ *
                  sandwichProductCore (k + 1) (fun i => Γ i.castSucc)
                    (fun i a => (G i.castSucc x).effect a)
                    (fun i => g i.castSucc) *
                  (G (Fin.last (k + 1)) x).effect
                    (g (Fin.last (k + 1)))).PosSemidef :=
              (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp hinner).conjTranspose_mul_mul_same _
            rw [MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus.measurement_effect_hermitian] at hpos
            exact hpos
          · change
              (∑ g : (i : Fin (k + 2)) → Γ i,
                sandwichProductCore (k + 2) Γ
                  (fun i a => (G i x).effect a) g) = 1
            calc
              (∑ g : (i : Fin (k + 2)) → Γ i,
                  sandwichProductCore (k + 2) Γ
                    (fun i a => (G i x).effect a) g) =
                  ∑ p : Γ (Fin.last (k + 1)) ×
                      ((i : Fin (k + 1)) → Γ i.castSucc),
                    sandwichProductCore (k + 2) Γ
                      (fun i a => (G i x).effect a) ((Fin.snocEquiv Γ) p) := by
                exact Fintype.sum_equiv (Fin.snocEquiv Γ).symm _ _
                  (by intro g; rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply])
              _ = ∑ a : Γ (Fin.last (k + 1)),
                    ∑ g : (i : Fin (k + 1)) → Γ i.castSucc,
                      (G (Fin.last (k + 1)) x).effect a *
                        sandwichProductCore (k + 1) (fun i => Γ i.castSucc)
                          (fun i b => (G i.castSucc x).effect b) g *
                        (G (Fin.last (k + 1)) x).effect a := by
                rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
                apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
                intro a _
                apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
                intro g _
                simp [sandwichProductCore]
              _ = ∑ a : Γ (Fin.last (k + 1)),
                    (G (Fin.last (k + 1)) x).effect a *
                      (∑ g : (i : Fin (k + 1)) → Γ i.castSucc,

/-- The sandwiched simultaneous-measurement estimate of `lem:ld-sandwich`.
One universal asymptotic constant applies independently of the distribution,
measurements, state, and error parameters. Blueprint
`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:398-425`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:465-501`. -/
theorem consistencyDefect_sandwich_le :
    ∃ C₀ : ℝ, 1 ≤ C₀ ∧
      ∀ {k : ℕ} {X Y ιA ιB : Type*} {R Γ : Fin k → Type*}
        [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype Y] [DecidableEq Y] [Nonempty Y]
        [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
        [∀ i, Fintype (R i)] [∀ i, DecidableEq (R i)]
        [∀ i, Fintype (Γ i)] [∀ i, DecidableEq (Γ i)]
        (μ : Distribution X)
        (eval : (i : Fin k) → Γ i → Y → R i)
        (G : (i : Fin k) → X → Measurement (Γ i) ιB)
        (A : X → Measurement ((i : Fin k) → Γ i) ιA)
        (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (ε δ : ℝ),
      μ.IsProbability → ‖ψ‖ = 1 → 0 < ε → 0 ≤ δ →
      (∀ i x, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (G i x)) →
      (∀ x, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (A x)) →
      (∀ i (g g' : Γ i), g ≠ g' →
        avgOver (uniformDistribution Y)
          (fun y => if eval i g y = eval i g' y then 1 else 0) ≤ ε) →
      (∀ i, consistencyDefect (Distribution.prod μ (uniformDistribution Y))
        (fun xy a => heteroKron (((A xy.1).postprocess
          (fun g => eval i (g i) xy.2)).effect a) 1)
        (fun xy a => heteroKron 1 (((G i xy.1).postprocess
          (fun g => eval i g xy.2)).effect a)) ψ ≤ δ) →
      consistencyDefect (Distribution.prod μ (uniformDistribution Y))
        (fun xy a => heteroKron (((A xy.1).postprocess
          (evalFunctionTuple eval xy.2)).effect a) 1)
        (fun xy a => heteroKron 1 (∑ g : (i : Fin k) → Γ i,
          if evalFunctionTuple eval xy.2 g = a then
            sandwichProduct (fun i x h => (G i x).effect h) xy.1 g else 0)) ψ ≤
        C₀ * (k : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (δ + ε) := by
  sorry

/-- The positive-mass conditional collision bound used by `lem:pasting`.
This is a formalization-only spelling of the conditional probability in
`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:442-469`, with paper origin
`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:504-525`. -/
def HasConditionalCollisionBound {X Y₁ Y₂ R₂ Γ₂ : Type*}
    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype Y₁] [DecidableEq Y₁]
    [Fintype Y₂] [DecidableEq Y₂] [Fintype R₂] [DecidableEq R₂]
    [Fintype Γ₂]
    (D : Distribution ((X × Y₁) × Y₂)) (eval₂ : Γ₂ → Y₂ → R₂)
    (η : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ x y₁, 0 < (D.map Prod.fst).weight (x, y₁) →
    ∀ g g' : Γ₂, g ≠ g' →
      (∑ y₂ : Y₂, D.weight ((x, y₁), y₂) *
        if eval₂ g y₂ = eval₂ g' y₂ then 1 else 0) ≤
        η * (D.map Prod.fst).weight (x, y₁)

/-- The effects obtained by sandwiching one measurement with a projective
measurement form a POVM. This is the measurement assertion for
`eq:pasting-2a`, blueprint `ch12_qpbt_games.tex:456-459`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:514-524`. -/
theorem pastedMeasurement_isMeasurement {Γ₁ Γ₂ ι : Type*}
    [Fintype Γ₁] [Fintype Γ₂] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (G₁ : Measurement Γ₁ ι) (G₂ : Measurement Γ₂ ι)
    (hG₂ : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective G₂) :
    (∀ g : Γ₁ × Γ₂,
      0 ≤ pastedMeasurement G₁.effect G₂.effect g.1 g.2) ∧
      (∑ g : Γ₁ × Γ₂,
        pastedMeasurement G₁.effect G₂.effect g.1 g.2) = 1 := by
  constructor
  · intro g
    unfold pastedMeasurement
    apply Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mpr
    have hpos : ((G₂.effect g.2)ᴴ * G₁.effect g.1 * G₂.effect g.2).PosSemidef :=
      (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (G₁.pos g.1)).conjTranspose_mul_mul_same
        (G₂.effect g.2)
    rw [MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus.measurement_effect_hermitian G₂ g.2] at hpos
    exact hpos

    64	    {alpha iota block : Type*}
    65	    [Fintype alpha] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    66	    [Fintype block] [DecidableEq block]
    67	    (M : block → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota) :
    68	    MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha (iota × block) :=
    69	  MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne
    70	    (fun a => Matrix.blockDiagonal fun r => (M r).effect a)
    71	    (fun a => Matrix.blockDiagonal_nonneg
    72	      (fun r => (M r).effect a) (fun r => (M r).pos a))
    73	    (by
    74	      ext ⟨i, r⟩ ⟨j, s⟩
    75	      simp only [Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.blockDiagonal_apply]
    76	      by_cases hrs : r = s
    77	      · subst s
    78	        simp only [if_pos]
    79	        calc
    80	          ∑ x, (M r).effect x i j = (1 : Matrix iota iota ℂ) i j :=
    81	            by
    82	              simpa only [Matrix.sum_apply] using
    83	                congrFun (congrFun (M r).sum_eq_one i) j
    84	          _ = (1 : Matrix (iota × block) (iota × block) ℂ)
    85	              (i, r) (j, r) := by
    86	                change (if i = j then 1 else 0) =
    87	                  (if (i, r) = (j, r) then 1 else 0)

    89	      · simp [hrs])

    30	/--

    32	`M : α → Op d` with `∑ a, M a ≤ 1`.
    33	-/
    34	structure Submeasurement (α : Type*) [Fintype α] (d : Type*) [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d] where
    35	  /-- The effect operators. -/
    36	  effect : α → Op d
    37	  /-- Each effect is positive semidefinite. -/
    38	  pos : ∀ a, 0 ≤ effect a
    39	  /-- The effects sum to at most the identity. -/

    44	-/

    72	    calc

    74	          = ∑ a, M.effect a := Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ f M.effect
    75	      _ ≤ 1 := M.sum_le_one

   274	    intro x a

   910	\subsubsection{Generating new measurements}
   911	
   912	In this section, we show how to combine multiple measurements into a single measurement by ``sandwiching" them together.
   913	
   914	\begin{fact}\label{fact:sandwich}
   915	Let $k \geq 0$ be a constant.
   916	Let $\{A^x_{a_1, \ldots, a_k}\}$ be a projective measurement.
   917	For each $1 \leq i \leq k$, let $\{(B_i)^x_{a_i}\}$ be a projective measurement, and suppose that
   918	\begin{equation}\label{eq:no-take-only-throw}
   919	(A^x_{a_i})_{\reg{Alice}} \otimes I_{\reg{Bob}} \simeq_{\delta} I_{\reg{Alice}} \otimes ((B_i)^x_{a_i})_{\reg{Bob}}.
   920	\end{equation}
   921	Define the POVM measurement $\{J^x_{g_1, \ldots, g_k}\}$ as
   922	\begin{equation*}
   923	J^x_{a_1, \ldots, a_k} := (B_k)^x_{a_k} \cdots (B_2)^x_{a_2} \cdot (B_1)^x_{a_1} \cdot (B_2)^x_{a_2} \cdots (B_k)^x_{a_k}.
   924	\end{equation*}
   925	Then
   926	\begin{equation*}
   927	(A^x_{a_1, \ldots, a_k})_{\reg{Alice}} \otimes I_{\reg{Bob}} \simeq_{\delta^{1/2}} I_{\reg{Alice}} \otimes (J^x_{a_1, \ldots, a_k})_{\reg{Bob}}.
   928	\end{equation*}
   929	\end{fact}
   930	\begin{proof}
   931	For each $1 \leq i \leq k$, 
   932	\Cref{eq:no-take-only-throw} implies that
   933	\begin{equation*}
   934	(A^x_{a_i})_{\reg{Alice}} \otimes I_{\reg{Bob}} \approx_{\delta} I_{\reg{Alice}} \otimes ((B_i)^x_{a_i})_{\reg{Bob}}.
   935	\end{equation*}
   936	Now, we repeatedly apply this using \Cref{fact:add-a-proj}:
   937	\begin{align*}
   938	(A^x_{a_1, \ldots, a_k})_{\reg{Alice}} \otimes I_{\reg{Bob}}
   939	& = (A^x_{a_k} \cdots A^x_{a_2} \cdot A^x_{a_1} \cdot A^x_{a_2} \cdots A^x_{a_{k}})_{\reg{Alice}} \otimes I_{\reg{Bob}}\\
   940	& \approx_{\delta} (A^x_{a_k} \cdots A^x_{a_2} \cdot A^x_{a_1} \cdot A^x_{a_2} \cdots A^x_{a_{k-1}})_{\reg{Alice}} \otimes ((B_k)^x_{a_k})_{\reg{Bob}}\\
   941	&\qquad\qquad\qquad \qquad \qquad \qquad \cdots\\
   942	& \approx_{\delta} I_{\reg{Alice}} \otimes ((B_k)^x_{a_k} \cdots (B_2)^x_{a_2} \cdot (B_1)^x_{a_1} \cdot (B_2)^x_{a_2} \cdots (B_k)^x_{a_k})_{\reg{Bob}}\\
   943	& = I_{\reg{Alice}} \otimes (J^x_{a_1, \ldots, a_k})_{\reg{Bob}}.
   944	\end{align*}
   945	The fact now follows from \Cref{fact:almost-agreement} and the fact that~$A$ is a projective measurement.
   946	\end{proof}
   947	
   948	Next, we extend \Cref{fact:sandwich} to the case of polynomial measurements (see \Cref{sec:classical-q-low-deg} below).
   949	These are structured measurements in which the prover returns the evaluation of a function sampled independently from their input.
   950	The goal is to retain this structure even after ``sandwiching" them together.
   951	
   952	\begin{fact}\label{fact:low-degree-sandwich}
   953	Let $k \geq 0$ be a constant.
   954	Let $\calD$ be a distribution on questions $x \in \calX$.
   955	For each $1 \leq i \leq k$, let $\calG_i$ be a set of functions $g_i : \calX \rightarrow \calR_i$.
   956	and let $\{G^i_g\}$ be a projective measurement with outcomes from this set.
   957	Suppose that the set $\calG_i$ has the following distance property:
   958	for any two nonequal $g_i, g_i' \in \calG_i$, the probability that $g_i(\bx) = g_i'(\bx)$, over a random $\bx \sim \calD$, is at most $\eps$.
   959	
   960	Let $\{A_{g_1, \ldots, g_k}\}$ be a projective measurement with outcomes $g_i \in \calF_i$.
   961	For each $1 \leq i \leq k$, suppose that
   962	\begin{equation}\label{eq:treat-yo-self}
   963	(A_{[g_i(x) = a_i]})_{\reg{Alice}} \otimes I_{\reg{Bob}} \simeq_{\delta} I_{\reg{Alice}} \otimes (G^i_{[g_i(x)=a_i]})_{\reg{Bob}}.
   964	\end{equation}
   965	Define the POVM measurement $\{J_{g_1, \ldots, g_k}\}$ as
   966	\begin{equation*}
   967	J_{g_1, \ldots, g_k} := G^k_{g_k} \cdots G^2_{g_2} \cdot G^1_{g_1} \cdot G^2_{g_2} \cdots G^k_{g_k}.
   968	\end{equation*}
   969	Then
   970	\begin{equation*}
   971	(A_{[g_1(x), \ldots, g_k(x) = a_1, \ldots, a_k]})_{\reg{Alice}} \otimes I_{\reg{Bob}} \simeq_{(\delta+\eps)^{1/2}} I_{\reg{Alice}} \otimes (J_{[g_1(x), \ldots, g_k(x) = a_1, \ldots, a_k]})_{\reg{Bob}}.
   972	\end{equation*}
   973	\end{fact}
   974	\begin{proof}
   975	Let $1 \leq i \leq k$.
   976	By~\Cref{eq:treat-yo-self},
   977	if Alice measures with~$A$, producing~$\bg_i$, and Bob measures with~$G^i$, producing~$\bg_i'$,
   978	then the probability that $\bg_i(\bx) \neq \bg_i'(\bx)$ is $O(\delta)$.
   979	Write $\eta$ for the probability that $\bg_i \neq \bg_i'$.
   980	Then we have the expression $\eta \cdot (1-\eps) \leq O(\delta)$ or, equivalently, $\eta \leq O(\delta/(1-\eps))$.
   981	When $\eps < 1/2$, this gives the bound $\eta \leq O(\delta)$, and when $\eps \geq 1/2$, we have the trivial bound $\eta \leq O(\eps)$.
   982	As a result, $\eta = O(\delta + \eps)$.
   983

import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Games.DistanceTheorems
import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Games.ErrorFunctions

/-! # Sandwiched measurements and pasting

This module defines the ordered palindromic products used to combine
measurements and records the two quantitative consistency statements imported
by the QPBT analysis.

## References

The source results are `lem:ld-sandwich` and `lem:pasting` in
`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:454-546`, with paper origin
`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:465-525`.
-/

open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder Matrix ComplexOrder

namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

open MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
open MIPStarRE.Quantum

/-- Recursive form of the palindromic operator product, extending a tuple by
placing its final operator on both sides of the preceding product. -/
private noncomputable def sandwichProductCore {ι : Type*}
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] :
    (k : ℕ) → (Γ : Fin k → Type*) →
      ((i : Fin k) → Γ i → Op ι) → ((i : Fin k) → Γ i) → Op ι
  | 0, _, _, _ => 1
  | 1, _, G, g => G 0 (g 0)
  | k + 2, Γ, G, g =>
      G (Fin.last (k + 1)) (g (Fin.last (k + 1))) *
        sandwichProductCore (k + 1) (fun i => Γ i.castSucc)
          (fun i a => G i.castSucc a) (fun i => g i.castSucc) *
        G (Fin.last (k + 1)) (g (Fin.last (k + 1)))

/-- The ordered product
`G^k_{g_k} ... G^1_{g_1} ... G^k_{g_k}` of `lem:ld-sandwich`.

**Local fix:** The source reverses the outcome indices, which is ill-typed when
the outcome families differ. This definition uses the pairing corrected in
`rem:ld-sandwich-indexing` and
`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-sandwich-indexing.tex`; blueprint statement
`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:454-480` and remark `ch12_qpbt_games.tex:485-487`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:465-501`. Tracked in
issue #16. The empty product is `1`. -/
noncomputable def sandwichProduct {k : ℕ} {X ι : Type*}
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {Γ : Fin k → Type*}
    (G : (i : Fin k) → X → Γ i → Op ι) (x : X)
    (g : (i : Fin k) → Γ i) : Op ι :=
  sandwichProductCore k Γ (fun i a => G i x a) g

/-- The two-family sandwiched product
`(G₂)_{g₂} (G₁)_{g₁} (G₂)_{g₂}` from `eq:pasting-2a`; blueprint
`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:517-546`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:504-525`. -/
def pastedMeasurement {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {G₁ G₂ : Type*} (M₁ : G₁ → Op ι) (M₂ : G₂ → Op ι)
    (g₁ : G₁) (g₂ : G₂) : Op ι :=
  M₂ g₂ * M₁ g₁ * M₂ g₂

/-- Evaluating a tuple of codewords at a common point. This is a
formalization-only auxiliary for `lem:ld-sandwich`, blueprint
`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:454-480`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:465-495`. -/
def evalFunctionTuple {k : ℕ} {Y : Type*} {R Γ : Fin k → Type*}
    (eval : (i : Fin k) → Γ i → Y → R i) (y : Y)
    (g : (i : Fin k) → Γ i) : (i : Fin k) → R i :=
  fun i => eval i (g i) y

/-- The palindromic effects form a POVM when each constituent measurement is
projective. This is `lem:ld-sandwich-measurement`, the measurement assertion
implicit in `lem:ld-sandwich`; blueprint `ch12_qpbt_games.tex:489-507`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:484-494`. -/
theorem sandwichProduct_isMeasurement {k : ℕ} {X ι : Type*}
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {Γ : Fin k → Type*}
    [∀ i, Fintype (Γ i)] (G : (i : Fin k) → X → Measurement (Γ i) ι)
    (hG : ∀ i x, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (G i x)) (x : X) :
    (∀ g : (i : Fin k) → Γ i,
      0 ≤ sandwichProduct (fun i x' a => (G i x').effect a) x g) ∧
      (∑ g : (i : Fin k) → Γ i,
        sandwichProduct (fun i x' a => (G i x').effect a) x g) = 1 := by
  classical
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      constructor
      · intro g
        change 0 ≤ (1 : Op ι)
        exact Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg
      · simp [sandwichProduct, sandwichProductCore]
  | succ k ih =>
      cases k with
      | zero =>
          constructor
          · intro g
            change 0 ≤ (G 0 x).effect (g 0)
            exact (G 0 x).pos (g 0)
          · change
              (∑ g : (i : Fin 1) → Γ i,
                (G 0 x).effect (g 0)) = 1
            calc
              (∑ g : (i : Fin 1) → Γ i, (G 0 x).effect (g 0)) =
                  ∑ p : Γ 0 × ((i : Fin 0) → Γ i.castSucc),
                    (G 0 x).effect (((Fin.snocEquiv Γ) p) 0) := by
                exact Fintype.sum_equiv (Fin.snocEquiv Γ).symm _ _
                  (by intro g; rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply])
              _ = ∑ a : Γ 0, (G 0 x).effect a := by
                rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
                apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
                intro a _
                simp only [Fintype.sum_unique]
                congr 1

      | succ k =>
          have hprev := ih
            (G := fun i x' => G i.castSucc x')
            (hG := fun i x' => hG i.castSucc x')
          constructor
          · intro g
            change 0 ≤
              (G (Fin.last (k + 1)) x).effect (g (Fin.last (k + 1))) *
                sandwichProductCore (k + 1) (fun i => Γ i.castSucc)
                  (fun i a => (G i.castSucc x).effect a)
                  (fun i => g i.castSucc) *
                (G (Fin.last (k + 1)) x).effect (g (Fin.last (k + 1)))
            have hinner := hprev.1 (fun i => g i.castSucc)
            apply Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mpr
            have hpos :
                (((G (Fin.last (k + 1)) x).effect (g (Fin.last (k + 1))))ᴴ *
                  sandwichProductCore (k + 1) (fun i => Γ i.castSucc)
                    (fun i a => (G i.castSucc x).effect a)
                    (fun i => g i.castSucc) *
                  (G (Fin.last (k + 1)) x).effect
                    (g (Fin.last (k + 1)))).PosSemidef :=
              (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp hinner).conjTranspose_mul_mul_same _
            rw [MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus.measurement_effect_hermitian] at hpos
            exact hpos
          · change
              (∑ g : (i : Fin (k + 2)) → Γ i,
                sandwichProductCore (k + 2) Γ
                  (fun i a => (G i x).effect a) g) = 1
            calc
              (∑ g : (i : Fin (k + 2)) → Γ i,
                  sandwichProductCore (k + 2) Γ
                    (fun i a => (G i x).effect a) g) =
                  ∑ p : Γ (Fin.last (k + 1)) ×
                      ((i : Fin (k + 1)) → Γ i.castSucc),
                    sandwichProductCore (k + 2) Γ
                      (fun i a => (G i x).effect a) ((Fin.snocEquiv Γ) p) := by
                exact Fintype.sum_equiv (Fin.snocEquiv Γ).symm _ _
                  (by intro g; rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply])
              _ = ∑ a : Γ (Fin.last (k + 1)),
                    ∑ g : (i : Fin (k + 1)) → Γ i.castSucc,
                      (G (Fin.last (k + 1)) x).effect a *
                        sandwichProductCore (k + 1) (fun i => Γ i.castSucc)
                          (fun i b => (G i.castSucc x).effect b) g *
                        (G (Fin.last (k + 1)) x).effect a := by
                rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
                apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
                intro a _
                apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
                intro g _
                simp [sandwichProductCore]
              _ = ∑ a : Γ (Fin.last (k + 1)),
                    (G (Fin.last (k + 1)) x).effect a *
                      (∑ g : (i : Fin (k + 1)) → Γ i.castSucc,
                        sandwichProductCore (k + 1) (fun i => Γ i.castSucc)
                          (fun i b => (G i.castSucc x).effect b) g) *
                      (G (Fin.last (k + 1)) x).effect a := by
                apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
                intro a _
                rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
              _ = ∑ a : Γ (Fin.last (k + 1)),
                    (G (Fin.last (k + 1)) x).effect a := by
                have hprevSum := hprev.2
                change
                  (∑ g : (i : Fin (k + 1)) → Γ i.castSucc,
                    sandwichProductCore (k + 1) (fun i => Γ i.castSucc)
                      (fun i b => (G i.castSucc x).effect b) g) = 1 at hprevSum
                apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
                intro a _
                rw [hprevSum, mul_one,
                  (hG (Fin.last (k + 1)) x a).isIdempotentElem.eq]
              _ = 1 := (G (Fin.last (k + 1)) x).sum_eq_one

/-- The sandwiched simultaneous-measurement estimate of `lem:ld-sandwich`.
One universal asymptotic constant applies independently of the distribution,
measurements, state, and error parameters. Blueprint
`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:454-480`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:465-501`. -/
theorem consistencyDefect_sandwich_le :
    ∃ C₀ : ℝ, 1 ≤ C₀ ∧
      ∀ {k : ℕ} {X Y ιA ιB : Type*} {R Γ : Fin k → Type*}
        [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype Y] [DecidableEq Y] [Nonempty Y]
        [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
        [∀ i, Fintype (R i)] [∀ i, DecidableEq (R i)]
        [∀ i, Fintype (Γ i)] [∀ i, DecidableEq (Γ i)]
        (μ : Distribution X)
        (eval : (i : Fin k) → Γ i → Y → R i)
        (G : (i : Fin k) → X → Measurement (Γ i) ιB)
        (A : X → Measurement ((i : Fin k) → Γ i) ιA)
        (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (ε δ : ℝ),
      μ.IsProbability → ‖ψ‖ = 1 → 0 < ε → 0 ≤ δ →
      (∀ i x, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (G i x)) →
      (∀ x, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (A x)) →
      (∀ i (g g' : Γ i), g ≠ g' →

          (fun y => if eval i g y = eval i g' y then 1 else 0) ≤ ε) →

        (fun xy a => heteroKron (((A xy.1).postprocess
          (fun g => eval i (g i) xy.2)).effect a) 1)

          (fun g => eval i g xy.2)).effect a)) ψ ≤ δ) →
      consistencyDefect (Distribution.prod μ (uniformDistribution Y))
        (fun xy a => heteroKron (((A xy.1).postprocess
          (evalFunctionTuple eval xy.2)).effect a) 1)
        (fun xy a => heteroKron 1 (∑ g : (i : Fin k) → Γ i,

            sandwichProduct (fun i x h => (G i x).effect h) xy.1 g else 0)) ψ ≤
        C₀ * (k : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (δ + ε) := by
  sorry

/-- The positive-mass conditional collision bound used by `lem:pasting`.
This is a formalization-only spelling of the conditional probability in
`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:517-546`, with paper origin
`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:504-525`. -/
def HasConditionalCollisionBound {X Y₁ Y₂ R₂ Γ₂ : Type*}
    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype Y₁] [DecidableEq Y₁]
    [Fintype Y₂] [DecidableEq Y₂] [Fintype R₂] [DecidableEq R₂]
    [Fintype Γ₂]
    (D : Distribution ((X × Y₁) × Y₂)) (eval₂ : Γ₂ → Y₂ → R₂)
    (η : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ x y₁, 0 < (D.map Prod.fst).weight (x, y₁) →
    ∀ g g' : Γ₂, g ≠ g' →
      (∑ y₂ : Y₂, D.weight ((x, y₁), y₂) *
        if eval₂ g y₂ = eval₂ g' y₂ then 1 else 0) ≤
        η * (D.map Prod.fst).weight (x, y₁)

/-- The effects obtained by sandwiching one measurement with a projective
measurement form a POVM. This is `lem:pasting-measurement`, the measurement
assertion for `eq:pasting-2a`; blueprint `ch12_qpbt_games.tex:548-567`, paper
`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:514-524`. -/
theorem pastedMeasurement_isMeasurement {Γ₁ Γ₂ ι : Type*}
    [Fintype Γ₁] [Fintype Γ₂] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (G₁ : Measurement Γ₁ ι) (G₂ : Measurement Γ₂ ι)
    (hG₂ : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective G₂) :
    (∀ g : Γ₁ × Γ₂,
      0 ≤ pastedMeasurement G₁.effect G₂.effect g.1 g.2) ∧
      (∑ g : Γ₁ × Γ₂,
        pastedMeasurement G₁.effect G₂.effect g.1 g.2) = 1 := by
  constructor
  · intro g
    unfold pastedMeasurement
    apply Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mpr
    have hpos : ((G₂.effect g.2)ᴴ * G₁.effect g.1 * G₂.effect g.2).PosSemidef :=
      (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (G₁.pos g.1)).conjTranspose_mul_mul_same
        (G₂.effect g.2)
    rw [MIPStarRE.QPBT.DistanceCalculus.measurement_effect_hermitian G₂ g.2] at hpos
    exact hpos
  · classical
    unfold pastedMeasurement
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, Finset.sum_comm]
    calc
      (∑ g₂ : Γ₂, ∑ g₁ : Γ₁,
          G₂.effect g₂ * G₁.effect g₁ * G₂.effect g₂) =
          ∑ g₂ : Γ₂,

        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro g₂ _

        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl

      _ = 1 := G₂.sum_eq_one

        (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ι × ι)) (η δ : ℝ),
        D.IsProbability → ‖ψ‖ = 1 → 0 ≤ η → 0 ≤ δ →
        (∀ x, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (G₂ x)) →
        (∀ q, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (A q)) →
        HasConditionalCollisionBound D eval₂ η →
        consistencyDefect D
          (fun q a₁ => heteroKron (((A q).postprocess Prod.fst).effect a₁) 1)
          (fun q a₁ => heteroKron 1 (((G₁ q.1.1).postprocess
            (fun g => eval₁ g q.1.2)).effect a₁)) ψ ≤ δ →
        consistencyDefect D
          (fun q a₂ => heteroKron (((A q).postprocess Prod.snd).effect a₂) 1)
          (fun q a₂ => heteroKron 1 (((G₂ q.1.1).postprocess
            (fun g => eval₂ g q.2)).effect a₂)) ψ ≤ δ →
        consistencyDefect D (fun q a => heteroKron ((A q).effect a) 1)
          (fun q a => heteroKron 1 ((A q).effect a)) ψ ≤ δ →
        consistencyDefect D (fun q a => heteroKron ((A q).effect a) 1)
          (fun q a => heteroKron 1 (∑ g₁ : Γ₁, ∑ g₂ : Γ₂,
            if (eval₁ g₁ q.1.2, eval₂ g₂ q.2) = a then
              pastedMeasurement (fun g => (G₁ q.1.1).effect g)
                (fun g => (G₂ q.1.1).effect g) g₁ g₂ else 0)) ψ ≤ δp η δ := by
  sorry
